shared_elements: circular/disc motif (rosettes in A, concentric circles in B)
justification: Both surfaces show upright anthropomorphic figures with raised arms and some round disc-like motifs (elaborate rosettes on a tree in A, concentric circles in B), but these are generic correspondences available to any tradition. A depicts a single large, highly detailed bird-headed winged being in profile with modelled musculature, feathered wings, fringed garment, bucket and cone beside a stylised sacred tree; B shows tiny stick-figure humans, boats with crew-strokes, and circles scattered without a unifying scene, so the manner of depiction and composition are wholly unrelated.
